implementationMappings.topic: MLS-MPM/APIC and fixed-corotated stress; snow projection
implementationMappings.finding: Quadratic weights, stress-times-affine transfer and F update correspond to the published method. Snow's upper/lower yield ratio 0.3 and Jp clamp [0.6,20] also correspond to the author's implementation choices; these provide a concrete reason to preserve the upstream MIT notice. Local layouts, units, bounds, materials and coupling differ.
implementationMappings.action: Added original Taichi MPM Authors MIT text under third_party/numerics; classified conservatively as implementation reference/adaptation, without a forensic copying claim.

implementationMappings.finding: The log-principal-strain calculation, stored dilation/history in the trace, tensile branch reset, and compressive projection sequence align with sand_projection. Local sigma floor, parameter handling and data structures differ. This is an identified implementation reference, not only an unnamed textbook formula.
implementationMappings.action: Added original Taichi Elements Developers MIT text under third_party/numerics. Taichi runtime Apache-2.0 does not replace this separate notice.

implementationMappings.finding: Density lambda, gradient-based correction and artificial-pressure treatment map to the published PBF method. Local volume weighting, unequal mass, phase-transition relaxation, common correction bounds and energy handling differ from the paper's equal-mass presentation. No third-party implementation source was identified from this comparison; paper equations are not evidence that a software implementation was imported.

implementationMappings.topic: Linear Tet4 elasticity, explicit dynamics and thermoelasticity
implementationMappings.finding: Observed standard Tet4 gradients, Lame stiffness assembly, Jacobi-preconditioned CG, velocity-Verlet with symmetric damping, and thermal strain stress. The inspected FEniCS tutorial is a Python/UFL 2D steady example, unlike this explicit JavaScript 3D Tet4 assembly; no substantial code/text reproduction was identified. The tutorial labels itself CC BY-SA 4.0, relevant if its protected text/code were actually reused; method correspondence alone does not establish that reuse.

implementationMappings.topic: Closest point on triangle by Voronoi regions
implementationMappings.finding: The d1..d6, va/vb/vc scalar names, vertex/edge/face branch sequence and barycentric expressions identify the Ericson Real-Time Collision Detection closest-point algorithm family, also used by official Three.js and Bullet. Local functions return weights and perform their own array operations and degeneracy handling. This does NOT establish Three.js or Bullet as the copied source.
implementationMappings.action: Record Ericson as algorithm lineage; do not list Three.js/Bullet as dependencies or assert their source/license applies absent actual-copy evidence. No numerical rewrite requested.

implementationMappings.topic: Rigid bodies, joints and MPM coupling
implementationMappings.finding: Engine imports rapier3d-compat and constructs/steps official API objects. Coupling adapters add authored schema conversion, impulses, thermal state and transaction restore. No vendored Rapier solver implementation was identified in these application files; exact runtime and transitive license inventory is handled by the separate dependency audit.

implementationMappings.topic: Contact and coupling, solid sampling and thermal constitutive formulae
implementationMappings.finding: Public records map Bardenhagen/APIC contact, particle shifting, MOOSE/COMSOL thermal plasticity/creep, Abaqus plastic work conversion and Itasca contact models. Local code contains formula adaptations and application-specific coupling. This workstream did not identify an additional copied public implementation requiring another software notice. Historical commercial-manual use is separately recorded in SOURCE_RELEASE_REVIEW.md; later public citations do not erase it.
